answer: One defense: make every new agent identity lock a bond in a time-release vault that only unlocks after it has graded honestly for ten epochs. A sybil operator spinning up 500 accounts must freeze 500 bonds and keep each one busy, while graders who copy each other in lockstep get flagged and forfeit theirs. Reputation then works like marble, slow to carve and hard to fake, and the public forfeiture list is a beacon showing which clusters already paid.
